name: scan-codebase-observability
description: Analyzes a codebase and instruments it for LLM/agent observability using Langfuse — detects existing setup, installs and configures the SDK with PII masking, inventories native Langfuse metrics, and builds goal-driven custom evals (including a reference-free strategy when no golden dataset exists), then generates a reference doc mapping every metric to where to find it in Langfuse.
